options.description: Regenerate stops and leaves the application source untouched, so newer work is not overwritten. You must bring the release up to date first. Recommended: You said the change should not lower the current quality of the delivered artifacts, and refusing is the only option that cannot overwrite newer work.
options.label: Refuse and change nothing (Recommended)

options.description: Regenerate builds the next revision and replaces the application source with your release edits, even if the source has changed since that release was built.
options.label: Build anyway and overwrite the source

payload.question:
If the application source has changed since the release you are regenerating from was built, should regenerate refuse to run, changing nothing, or build anyway?

You said: "of course it shouldnt impact negatively the current quality of delivery of those artifacts"
payload.text: Build anyway and overwrite the source
